records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for the kind words on the onboarding flow in your ticket -- it's still open on our side, and glad the first week has gone smoothly even while you get used to the layout.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, creating that first project is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and you can invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through setting up your first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
